parents.title: Babysitter Information Sheet
parents.subtitle: For Emma & Leo · Thanks for coming!

kids.name: Emma
kids.allergy: Peanuts (severe). EpiPen is in the kitchen drawer by the fridge.
kids.food: Pasta in the fridge, 1 minute in the microwave.
kids.bed: Bath, pajamas, 2 books. Lights out 8:00 PM.
kids.comfort: Bunny named Pip. Leave the nightlight on.
kids.notes: Will ask for a 3rd book. One more is fine.

kids.name: Leo
kids.food: Same pasta, cut small. Milk in a sippy cup.
kids.bed: Diaper, 1 book, white noise on. Asleep by 7:30 PM.
kids.comfort: Blue blanket. Rub his back if he cries.
kids.notes: Gets cranky when tired. That's normal.

rules.screen: 30 min of shows after dinner. Kids profile only.
rules.snacks: Fruit or yogurt. No candy tonight.
rules.visitors: Don't open the door for anyone you don't know.
rules.other: Help yourself to anything in the fridge.

home.tv: Kids profile on the living room TV
home.where: Flashlight in the kitchen drawer. Pajamas in the top dresser drawer.
home.pets: Our cat Luna may hide. Please don't let her out.

example.notes: Pizza money is on the counter if you'd rather order in. Thank you!
